较热的冷媒向室内放热，逐渐凝结成液体。房间收到搬来的热，也收到电功最终变成的热。: Hotter refrigerant releases heat to the room and condenses into liquid. The room receives the transported heat and the heat from electrical work.

温度不会一下子跳到目标值。这里的定速压缩机会停一停，再工作；有些真实冰箱使用变速: Temperature does not jump to a target. This fixed-speed compressor stops and restarts; some real refrigerators regulate variable speed.
金色圆框追踪管内的一小份冷媒；小圆点是放大符号。这里单独解释机器工作时的一圈，不: The gold circle tracks a small portion of refrigerant inside the pipes; dots are enlarged symbols. This separately explains a running cycle, not a compressor that runs all the time.
食物把热传给周围空气和较冷的内壁。冷媒在管内吸热，再把热带到箱外。它不会流进食物: Food transfers heat to surrounding air and cooler inner surfaces. Refrigerant absorbs heat inside its pipes and carries it outside. It never flows into food or sprays out as cold air.
保温层和门封减慢热量进入。开门时，较暖的空气进来，冷空气流出去；冰箱又要多搬一些: Insulation and door seals slow incoming heat. Opening the door lets warmer air in and cooler air out, giving the refrigerator more heat to move.
散到房间的热，包含从箱内搬出的热，也包含机器消耗的电能。所以把门一直敞着，不能靠: Heat released into the room includes heat removed from inside and the electrical energy used. Leaving the door open cannot cool the whole room.

工作循环中，蒸发器吸热 Qc，压缩机接受功 W，冷凝器向室内放热 Qh。忽略一个: Over an operating cycle the evaporator absorbs Qc, the compressor receives work W, and the condenser releases Qh. With no net internal energy change over the full cycle, Qh = Qc + W. COP = Qc/W can exceed 1 because it measures heat moved per input work, not energy created.
低压冷媒在蒸发器中吸热、部分或全部汽化。压缩机吸入蒸气并提高压力与温度；冷凝器先: Low-pressure refrigerant absorbs heat and vaporizes in the evaporator. The compressor raises vapor pressure and temperature. The condenser first cools hot vapor, then condenses it. Liquid passes through a capillary or other throttling device, losing pressure and partially flashing. The cooler mixture returns to the evaporator. Throttling does not recover the compressor work as electricity.
